further statement of Tsiang Khe Zung (蔣凱成)
C.S. Black 南诚

Y'poo Stn. 31/3/34

Further of my first statement, I have been interrogated
as to my knowledge of the man Hwang Ching Van (黃金範). The
first thing I knew of his arrest was when I heard the detective
from the Public Safety Bureau tell the Judge in court the mor-
ning on which I was arraigned before him.

I first became acquainted with Hwang in 1925 when I went
to Nanking and procured a job in the Civil Governor's office, Yu
Tiao Yuen was the governor at that time and Hwang was working
in the telegram department.

The next time I met Hwang was two years after I arrived in
Shanghai (about 193_). On this occasion I attended a dinner
party given by Mr S _u Hwan (贺啸寰) secretary of the Shanghai
Mint. At that time Hwang was working as a clerk in the Nantao
City court.

A year later I met Hwang at a dinner given by Lawyer Wu
Chien Pang (吴建邦) who is a life-long friend of mine. At that
time Hwang was working as a clerk in Lawyer Wu' office.

I have met Hwang on several occasions since then at the
office of Lawyer Wu, when I visit occasionally.

I cannot recollect ever having written a letter to Hwang
Ching Van, and the only reason I can think of as to how my name
came into his possession is that he may have a visiting card of
mine which I gave to him during the exchange of courtesy at the
time of the dinners where I met him.

This is my true statement.

(签名: Tsiang Khe Zung 31/3/34)

Stated by Tsiang Khe Zung.

蒋凯成（Tsiang Khe Zung，蔣凱成）的进一步供词
C.S. Black 南诚

杨树浦巡捕房。1934年3月31日

继我第一份供词之后，我就对黄金范（Hwang Ching Van，黃金範）一事的了解接受了讯问。我第一次得知他被捕，是在我被提审的那天上午，听到公安局的侦探在法庭上告诉法官的时候。

我初次认识黄金范是在1925年，当时我去南京并在民政公署找到一份工作，余条元（Yu Tiao Yuen）是当时的省长，黄金范在电报部门工作。

下一次见到黄金范是我到上海两年后（约193_年）。那次我参加了上海造币厂秘书贺啸寰（Mr S _u Hwan，贺啸寰）举办的晚宴。当时黄金范在南市地方法院担任职员。

一年后，我在我的终身好友吴建邦（Wu Chien Pang，吴建邦）律师举办的宴会上再次见到黄金范。当时黄金范在吴律师的办公室担任职员。

此后，我在偶尔拜访吴律师办公室时又几次见到黄金范。

我不记得曾给黄金范写过信，我能想到的我的名字落入他手中的唯一原因，可能是我在与他共进晚餐并互致礼节时给他的名片。

这是我的真实供词。

(签名: Tsiang Khe Zung 1934年3月31日)

Accused Tsang Kho Sung ( ) Age 50. School teacher.

Charge Application for Handing Over.
Application is hereby made by the P.S.Bureau for the
handing over of the above named accused, who was arrested
at 9.15 p.m. 27/2/34 at 7 Lieu Tshung Li, Yangtszepoo Road,
on suspicion of his being a communist under authority of
warrant No. 1846.
Rept. Tsang Kho Soo.

IN THE SECOND BRANCH OF THE KIANGSU HIGH COURT. A.M.
Mr T.Y Chang appeared for the S.M. Council.
Mr Tsiang Kuh Fong appeared for the accused.

Proceedings.
Mr Chang :- In this case at 9.15.p.m. on the 27th inst,
acting on authority of this search warrant, and this arrest warrant,
(handed to Judge), the representatives of the Public Safety Bureau,
requested the Settlement Police to assist them in arresting the
accused at No 7 Lieu Tshung Li, Y'poo Road. Assistance was according
ly rendered and the accused was arrested. A careful search was made
of the accused's room, but nothing could be found of a Communistic
nature. At the Police Station, the accused was questioned but he
denied that he was a communist, or that he was in any way connected
with the Communist party. Moreover he states that he is a school
teacher of the Kong Mir Yuen Missionary school, and has been employed
there for the past six years. The School Mistress was located, and
her statement coincided with that of the accused. She made special
mention, that the accused is a Christian and of excellent character.
The Political Section (S.M.P.) together with detectives from Y.
'Poo Station, have made enquiries and find that the statement of
the accused and the School Mistress are correct. I understand that
the P.S.Bureau have no evidence to offer, except that sometime ago
a person was arrested by them, and on his possession was found a
list of names one of which was that of the accused. The person
arrested referred to, was found to be a communist therefore it would
seem that the P.S.B. are of the opinion that this accused together
with the others mentioned on the list mentioned are also communists.

公共安全局特此申请移交上述被告，该被告于1934年2月27日晚9时15分在杨树浦路留春里7号被捕，涉嫌为共产党分子，依据第1846号逮捕令执行。
报告人：曾克苏 (Tsang Kho Soo)。

在江苏高等法院第二分院。上午。
张廷扬 (T.Y Chang) 先生代表工部局出庭。
蒋谷丰 (Tsiang Kuh Fong) 先生代表被告出庭。

诉讼过程。
张先生：- 在本案中，本月27日晚9时15分，依据本搜查令和本逮捕令（已呈交法官），公共安全局的代表请求租界巡捕房协助他们在杨树浦路留春里7号逮捕被告。警方随即提供了协助，被告被捕。对被告的房间进行了仔细搜查，但未发现任何具有共产主义性质的物品。在警察局，被告受到讯问，但他否认自己是共产党分子，或声称与共产党有任何关联。此外，他声称自己是孔孟园教会学校的教师，并在那里受雇已达六年。找到了该校女校长，她的陈述与被告一致。她特别提到，被告是一名基督徒，品行优良。政治部（工部局警务处）会同杨树浦分站的侦探进行了调查，发现被告和女校长的陈述属实。我了解到，公共安全局除了不久前他们逮捕了一人，并在其身上发现一份名单，其中包含被告的名字外，没有提供其他证据。所提及的被捕者被证实为共产党分子，因此公共安全局似乎认为，该被告以及名单上提到的其他人也是共产党分子。

Chang Kai Sung (蔣開成)。
Y'poo Stn. 27-3-14.
~~Denis Golder~~
A. R. Kingard.
Translated by D.S.J. Liu.

My name is Chang Kai Sung. I am 50 years of age and a native of Tai Hu Hsien, Anhwei. I am married and have four children, two sons and two daughters. I am a Christian and belong to the Methodist Religion. I was born in the town of Tai Hu Hsien. My father and mother are both dead. Formerly, my father Chiang Yung Chuan (蔣錦傳) was a shopkeeper at Tai Hu Hsien. I started studying with a private tutor when I was 7 years old, and when I was 18 years old I went to the Provincial Government Normal School at Anking; in Anhwei, where I studied for 3 years. The subjects I studied were those usually learnt by those who were studying to become school teachers, that is, Geography, Mathematics, History and Chinese. On leaving this school I went to the Toong Wen Hau Yeun (同文書院), a Methodist missionary school, outside the south gate of Wukiang. The name of this school has now been changed to Williams Nast College. I remained at this school for two years, during which time I studied in the Divinity class, as I wanted to become a Methodist missionary. On leaving the Toong Wen Hau Yeun I returned to Tai Hu Hsien where I entered the "Foo Ying Jaung" as a school teacher, and a preacher. I remained at this place for one year and three months, after which I left to go to Tsinanfu, Shantung, to join a friend of mine Hong Shou Ts (洪京之) who cabled me to go to him at once, as he had a job for me, as a council official. My friend Mr. Hong was secretary to the Governor of Shantung. I assumed the post of council official immediately on arrival, and held this post for four months. I was then appointed Director of the Salt Gabelle at Hai Cho
pages.zh:
蒋开成（Chang Kai Sung）。
杨树浦巡捕房。1914年3月27日。
~~丹尼斯·戈尔德~~
A. R. 金加德。
刘D.S.J. 译。

我叫蒋开成。现年50岁，籍贯安徽太湖县。已婚，育有四名子女，两子两女。我是基督徒，信奉卫理公会。我出生于太湖县城。父母均已去世。父亲蒋锦传（Chiang Yung Chuan）生前在太湖县经营一家店铺。我7岁时开始随私塾先生读书，18岁时进入位于安徽安庆的省立师范学校，在那里学习了三年。所学课程为师范生通常修习的科目，即地理、数学、历史和中文。从该校毕业后，我前往吴江南门外的同文书院（Toong Wen Hau Yeun），这是一所卫理公会传教士创办的学校。该校现已更名为威廉纳斯特学院（Williams Nast College）。我在该校就读两年，期间在神学科学习，因为我希望成为一名卫理公会传教士。离开同文书院后，我回到太湖县，在“福音堂”担任教员兼传道人。我在那里待了一年三个月，随后离开前往山东济南府，去投奔我的朋友洪京之（Hong Shou Ts），他曾发电报让我立即前去，因为他有一份政府官员的工作提供给我。我的朋友洪先生是山东省督军的秘书。我抵达后立即就任该政府官员职位，并任职四个月。之后，我被任命为河南睢州（Hai Cho）盐务局局长

pages.en:
( 2 )

(睢州), Honan, and this appointment I held for a year and
9 months. After this I returned to my native town Tai Hu
Hsien. I remained in Tai Hu Hsien for eight years, living
on the farm which had been left to me by my father at his death.
During these eight years I spent all my time engaged on my farm.
As my father had been a man of high social standing
and had often acted as arbitrator in the social squabbles of
the local residents, I now found myself holding a similar
position, and so was kept quite busy.

During the year 1926 I was taken prisoner by the army
of the General Li Chung Jen (李宗仁) of the 7th Army, and held
captive for five months in Huang Mei (黄梅) Hsien, Hupeh. I
was released on the defeat of Li Chung Jen by General Tsa T'ou
Ting, when I went to live at Nanking. I did not dare to go back
to my home owing to the political situation there. After I
had spent a year in Nanking living on my income I came to
Shanghai. I arrived in Shanghai about October 1927, when I
went to live at No.10 Lieu Tshung Li, Yangtsze Road, the
house in which I was arrested today. From October 1927 to
January 1st 1928 I was considering taking a post as teacher
in the Chinese Christian Day Nursery, No.3 Lieu Tshung Li,
Yangtsepoo Road, which is run by Miss Mei Zah Yuin Ying, a
lady friend of mine whom I had met at Kiukiang some years
before. I started as a half day teacher on January 1st 1934.
This meant my spending the morning teaching and the afternoon
canvassing for pupils among the neighbours. After six months
I became a full day teacher, and I have occupied this post
pages.zh:
( 2 )

（睢州），我在该职位上任职一年九个月。此后，我返回家乡太湖县。我在太湖县居住了八年，依靠父亲去世后留给我的农场生活。在这八年里，我将全部时间都花在经营农场上。由于父亲社会地位较高，且经常充当当地居民社会纠纷的仲裁人，我发现自己也处于类似的地位，因此事务相当繁忙。

1926年间，我被第七军军长李宗仁（Li Chung Jen）的部队俘虏，并在湖北黄梅县被囚禁了五个月。当李宗仁被曹锟廷将军（Tsa T'ou Ting，音译）击败后，我获释，随即前往南京居住。由于那里的政治局势，我不敢回家乡。在南京靠收入生活了一年后，我来到上海。我于1927年10月左右抵达上海，居住在杨树浦路留泰里10号，也就是我今天被捕的那所房子。从1927年10月到1928年1月1日，我一直在考虑接受杨树浦路留泰里3号中华基督教日间托儿所的教员职位，该托儿所由梅玉英女士（Mei Zah Yuin Ying）经营，她是我几年前在九江结识的一位女性朋友。我于1934年1月1日开始担任半日制教员。这意味着我上午教书，下午在邻居中招收学生。六个月后，我成为全日制教员，并且一直担任此职

pages.en:
( 3 )

ever since.

I occupy the downstairs front room of No.10 Lieu Tah ng
Li, Yangtsepo Road which is rented in the name of Miss Mei
Yuin Ying. I am a bonafide resident of the International
Settlement, and Miss Mei Yuin Ying can testify to this.
I am not a Communist and have never had any dealings with
the Communist party.

This statement is true.

Stated by Chang Tai Sung.
pages.zh:
( 3 )

至今。

我居住在杨树浦路留泰里10号的楼下前间，该房屋是以梅玉英小姐的名义租赁的。我是公共租界的合法居民，梅玉英小姐可以为此作证。我不是共产党员，也从未与共产党有任何往来。

以上陈述属实。

陈述人：蒋太松（Chang Tai Sung，音译）。
